column1: # Curated symbol table for the MStar MST9U (AEON) scaler AP.
# Our own annotations (not vendor symbols) — edit freely and re-run regen.sh.
# Addresses are RAM, image = COMBINED (ap_prefix.bin + ap_decompressed.bin) at
# 0x180000 (i.e. the inflated stream sits at 0x183800). Applied after the auto
# namer so these override it. Confidence: [C]=confirmed [I]=inferred [?]=tentative.

# low). Rebuild from fresh regen.sh dumps / the auto tsv. A few base-fixed
# anchors below, re-derived on the correct base:
